reference_stack_found_outside_this_repos.reason: Its stock velocity policy uses a one-frame 29-action interface and has no stair CBF; v139 uses a term-major five-history 405-D input and 12 lower-body actions.

required_gates.requires: robot identity, firmware/SDK versions, staircase geometry, baseline/evaluation counts, operator and safety-reviewer sign-off
exact term order, oldest-to-newest five-sample buffers, training-compatible IMU/joint/command/phase semantics, and first-frame backfill
verified Unitree joint-index mapping, lower-body scale/offset parity, approved fixed upper-body posture, and hardware joint/velocity/torque limits
robot pose relative to fixed measured risers, foot positions, foot Jacobians, synchronized contact and joint state
hardware-side parity for nominal-to-safe projection at every 20 ms policy step, plus fail-closed behavior when required state is stale or invalid
operator takeover, verified emergency stop, watchdog, support rig/fall protection, workspace exclusion, and approved abort thresholds
the exact deployment bridge and CBF must pass suspended and unitree_mujoco/hardware-in-the-loop tests before stair contact
raw nominal action storage, executed safe action logging, reward/termination reconstruction, fixed two-round PPO update, and no hardware-outcome checkpoint selection

hard_stop: Do not launch g1_ctrl or send motor commands from this repository while any required gate is missing.
next_authoritative_input: A robot operator must complete and sign real_robot_run_manifest.template.json and provide access to the exact controller/SDK checkout and robot test setup.
